blockers: enriched_vecEA2_until witness ordering: BracketFormula n with n = pos_between.length uses Fintype.elems ordering for pointTypes, but IntervalPattern.holds requires model-linear-order-compatible witness ordering. Goal at L2096: BracketFormula.holds M atomMap vea.snd.bracket t x. Unprovable for n >= 2 with adversarial models. Fix: replace bracket with conjunction of individual Formula.untl existentials for between_tx zone (like above_x/eq_x zones are already handled).

continuation_context.architectural_fix_needed: enriched_vecEA2_until between_tx encoding — replace BracketFormula with conjunction of individual existentials
continuation_context.key_analysis: IntervalPattern.holds requires strictly increasing witnesses w_0 < ... < w_{n-1} where w_i satisfies pointTypes i. The pointTypes are indexed by pos_between list order (Fintype.elems), but model witnesses may not be in this order. Sorting witnesses permutes alpha indices, breaking the match. The fix is to not use BracketFormula at all for between_tx — just use separate Formula.untl for each positive SSN.
